privacy.newly_authored_data_profile: One business contact record per current customer; employer contact, employment, payroll, tax and benefit enrollment fields for 702 employees. The declared August commercial services contain no clinical PHI, personal-data sales, cross-context advertising, precise-location tracking or biometric identification. No real private payloads are authored.
privacy.subsidiary_disposition: Enterprise internal data policy applies. Assess CCPA control, common branding and shared personal information per entity; financial consolidation alone is insufficient. No universal subsidiary exemption claimed.
data_classes: Business contact identity and work contact
Workforce jurisdiction, time, compensation and tax deductions
Client confidential operational observations; no clinical PHI in declared August services

performance.notice_delivery_population: 702 employee source IDs and 88 customer-contact source IDs; separate population units, not 790 employees
performance.notice_origin: New synthetic August 1 employee-portal and customer-onboarding notices. Content below; retrospective availability September 15.
performance.notice_content: Collect personal information for employment, payroll, benefits, customer performance, security and legal recordkeeping. Route access, correction and deletion requests through the synthetic privacy owner; verify identity and record applicable retention exceptions. No sale or cross-context advertising in this declared scope. Retention follows record-class and legal-hold schedules, with no perpetual default.
performance.reviewer_role: Privacy owner independent of payroll preparer
